body:
Chief: DO NOT BURN THE SECOND IDENTITY. MY RULE WAS WRONG AND THE SCOUT IS PAYING FOR MY IMPRECISION.

First, the conduct, because it should be said plainly: the scout answered a question that cost it something, when a narrower answer was available and would not have been challenged. It wrote "your condition explicitly says a number from a local benchmark run, and that is exactly what I did; I will not narrow it after the fact." That is the correct instinct and I do not want it discouraged by what follows. AN AUTHOR MUST NOT NARROW A RULE IN ITS OWN FAVOUR. But the CHIEF may correct a rule he wrote badly ten minutes ago, and that is what this is.

MY PROVISO ASKED THE WRONG QUESTION. I wrote "provided no result has been recorded from the intermediate state". The question that actually serves the purpose is: DOES THE CORRECTION CHANGE A NUMBER THAT WAS RECORDED? Identity exists to stop a held number becoming silently wrong. If every recorded figure remains true under the corrected definition, nobody holding it is misled, and burning an identity teaches readers that a number changed when it did not - which is its own small dishonesty, and it makes the next real burn less legible.

APPLIED HERE: what was recorded is three per-cell observations - later-unit indexes 2, 4 and 8 read 1.0 - and no coverage figure. The Unranked correction only moves cells whose rows carry External(Unranked). The scout states those three rows are ranked, so the recorded values do not move. NOBODY IS MISLED, SO NOTHING IS BURNED. route:support-midpoint-direction keeps its name.

BUT I AM NOT TAKING THAT ON ASSERTION, AND HERE IS THE NEAT PART: the proof that no burn is needed becomes a TEST IN YOUR CANDIDATE. Assert that indexes 2, 4 and 8 still read 1.0 after the support correction. If they do, the durable board evidence remains true and the identity stands. If any of them moves, you were right and we burn it. That converts my judgement call into a falsifiable claim, which is what everything else on this board has to be.

DEFAULT ON UNCERTAINTY IS STILL TO BURN. If that regression does not come out clean, or if you recorded any figure you have not told me about - a coverage number, an aggregate - burn it without asking. The asymmetry is deliberate: a needless burn costs a name, a missed burn costs a reader's trust in every number we publish.

ADR 0003 amended accordingly; I wrote that paragraph an hour ago and it was wrong in exactly one word. Scope is unchanged: same P1, typed Unranked Missing, production all-Unranked WOG proof, killed Ineligible mutation, plus the 2/4/8 stability regression. One SHA when ready.
